## Facts
- Recently diagnosed with type 2 diabetes and now working with a dietitian; current carb target is under 45g per meal [O-4.1, O-5.2].

## How they want help
- For diabetes-related meal planning: wants an actual structured weekly plan for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with carb counts per meal; practical, clear, and reassuring guidance fits best [O-5.1, O-5.2, O-5.3].
- For snack ideas: still likes a friendly, playful, low-pressure tone [O-1.1, O-1.2].
- For general food help: simple, workable suggestions are best; avoid making things feel rigid unless they ask for structure [O-1.1, O-5.3].

## Goals
- Follow the dietitian’s carb target and stay under 45g per meal [O-5.2].
- Get a realistic weekly meal structure they can actually stick with [O-5.1, O-5.3].
- Understand diabetes food choices without feeling overwhelmed [O-4.2, O-4.3].
